requirement: Bicycles having a single front sprocket and a single rear sprocket shall have a chain guard that covers the top strand of the chain and at least 90° of the perimeter where the drive chain contacts the drive sprocket. The chain guard shall extend rearward to a point at least 8 cm (3.2 in) forward of the centerline of the rear axle. The minimum width of the top area shall be twice the width of the chain forward of the rear wheel rim; the rear part may be tapered to one-half the chain width.
requirement_summary: Single-speed: chain guard covers top chain + 90° sprocket, extends ≥8cm past rear axle, width ≥2× chain

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain chain guard component
Product drawing showing chain guard coverage area (at least 90° and 8cm extension)

remediation: Install a chain guard covering the top chain and sprocket engagement area for at least 90° of circumference, extending at least 8cm forward of the rear axle centerline per §1512.9(a).

requirement: The chain guard shall prevent a 9.4mm (3/8in) diameter, 76mm (3in) long test rod from being caught between the chain and sprocket when inserted from the chain side at any angle within a 45° range.
requirement_summary: Chain guard must prevent 9.4mm test rod from being caught in chain/sprocket within 45° range

evidence_required.description: Chain guard pinch test report per §1512.9(a) using 9.4mm × 76mm test rod
Product drawing with clearance dimensions between chain guard and chain/sprocket

remediation: Redesign chain guard to prevent a 9.4mm × 76mm test rod from being caught between chain and sprocket at any angle within 45° per §1512.9(a).

requirement: Derailleurs shall be provided with a guard device to prevent the chain from interfering with or stopping the rotation of the wheel due to improper adjustment or damage.
requirement_summary: Derailleur must have guard to prevent chain from blocking wheel rotation

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain derailleur guard component
Product photo showing derailleur guard installed

remediation: Install a derailleur guard that prevents chain from interfering with or stopping wheel rotation per §1512.9(b).
